title: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced VM Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning a MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 8.3.2 VM instance on IBM Z (s390x)

cluster_url.description: Target cluster server URL (optional, defaults to broker's cluster). Must be a registered ArgoCD cluster.

database_name.description: Name of the application database to create

database_password.description: Application database user password (auto-generated if not provided)

root_password.description: MongoDB root admin password (auto-generated if not provided)

vm_root_password.description: VM OS root password (auto-generated if not provided)

source_container_disk.description: Full MongoDB EA s390x VM container disk image reference, including registry, repository, and tag

ha_enabled.description: Enable High Availability replica set deployment

ha_replica_count.description: Number of replica set members for High Availability (must be odd: 3, 5, or 7)

vm_cpu_cores.description: Number of vCPU cores per VM

disk_size_gi.description: Boot disk size per VM in GiB
